title: PyQuest · Village landmarks 2.5D
provenance: Original AI-generated illustrations made for this project using Arena image generation. No downloaded stock artwork or third-party reference image was supplied to generation. The generated python_academy.png was used as the style reference for the other five images.
rights_note: Not a CC0 stock pack. No third-party stock license is asserted. Review applicable image-generation service terms and project release policy before distribution.
format_note: Opaque RGB illustrations with baked ivory background and ground shadow. Suitable for cards/thumbnails, NOT transparent compositing sprites, 3D models, animated NPCs or navigable map tiles.

recipe.camera: Fixed orthographic 3/4 isometric appearance; target 30-degree elevation. Generated images approximate this, not calibrated geometry.
recipe.light: Warm upper-left key light, ambient occlusion, lower-right cast shadow.
recipe.materials: Beveled low-poly limestone, teal roofs, walnut details, sage grass and amber accents; modest texture; no heavy outlines.
recipe.composition: One complete isolated landmark on a compact diamond-shaped sandstone/grass base, square canvas, clear margins, pale ivory background.
recipe.exclude: Text, labels, UI, watermarks, recognizable third-party characters, unrelated buildings, crowds, grids or collages.

assets.name: Tháp Python
assets.motif: Tháp đá sáng, mái teal nhọn, sách mở và cửa sổ hổ phách.
assets.subject_prompt: An elegant ivory limestone octagonal academy tower, teal faceted conical roof with gold finial, two levels of amber arched windows, walnut entrance, open-book emblem without letters, curved stone steps, cobble path, two low-poly trees and small blue crystal.
assets.review_notes: Background and shadow baked in. Do not use as a walkable maze, hitbox or layered terrain tile.
